learning_outcomes.text: Can solve any kind of homogeneous and non-homogeneous linear equation system.
To be able to calculate determinants of square matrices by using determinant properties.
A square decides whether the matrix is reversible and, if reversible, can calculate the inverse.
Define the concepts of vector space and subspace with examples.
Can interpret whether a subset of a vector space is linear independent.
Calculate the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of matrices.
Calculate the inner product of vectors in Real and Complex vector spaces

syllabus_topics: Linear equation systems and Gauss elimination method.
Application of matrices to systems of linear equations
Elementary column operations and equivalent matrices
Vector space, subspaces and linear independence
Inner product in real and complex spaces
bibliography: Seymour Lipschutz,, Theory and Problems of Linear Algebra,, 2nd Ed., Schaum Outline Series, McGraw-Hill Book Company, 1991. Linear Algebra Theory and Problems from Schaum Series Ceb, Nobel Yayın Dağıtım, Ankara, 1991.

Neşe Ömür, Yücel Türker Ulutaş. Algebra and Solution Problems Yayın, Umuttepe Publications, Kocaeli University, 2015. Frank Ayres, Matrices, Schaumems Outline Series, Translated by Gülsüm Oral, Matrices with Theory and Problems, Sanem Solution Series Güven Kitabevi Yayınları, 1980.
